caption:
Can someone explain why every checkout now asks for a tip before I even get my food? 😅
I'm happy to tip well. I just want to know the service happened first.
Am I the only one who feels the pressure?
first_comment: Where's the weirdest place a tip screen has ever popped up on you? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Tip screens everywhere... where's the weirdest one? Tell @paychecktruths 👇
